cases.name: Tara Marie Serino
cases.about: Her obituary said Tara had a deep faith in God and a beautiful spirit. God called her home on All Saints Day. She was generous and caring, artistic and open-minded, and had a positive outlook on life. Tara loved to be surrounded by nature, which inspired her passion for photography, especially of the earth and sky.
